decisions.reason: The notebook imports and uses Qiskit for the quantum classifier, confirming Qiskit as the simulator framework.
The quantum kernel is built with ZZFeatureMap (an angle/Pauli-Z data-encoding feature map), which conflicts with the extracted 'amplitude' encoding for the same quantum model.
The quantum classifier's accuracy score of 0.974 is printed in the notebook output and is a distinct metric not already in the extraction.
